items.title: How much real signal actually gets through?
items.description: L2's model has two independent levers: how narrow the question is, and how safe the person feels being candid with you. Drag "How narrow the question is" down toward 0 to reproduce Request 1's "any feedback?" (near-zero signal, even with decent trust) — then drag it up toward Request 2 and 3's territory and watch how much safety changes the ceiling on what you can extract.
items.compute: const raw = 3 * (params.specificity / 100); const multiplier = 0.2 + 0.8 * (params.safety / 100); const signal = Math.round(raw * multiplier * 10) / 10; return { signal };
